overview_description.description:
Vaasara is a Dubai-based startup founded in 2018 that focuses on simplifying the booking process for beauty and wellness services. Its platform enables users to browse salons, spas, and clinics, check ratings, availability, distance, and opening times, and instantly schedule appointments online.

The company also supports service providers by offering a digital marketplace, marketing tools, and customer management solutions, helping salons and wellness businesses attract new clients and increase revenue.
